sentences.zh: 这是我的书。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de shū.
sentences.en: This is my book.

sentences.zh: 我妈妈做的菜很好吃。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ māma zuò de cài hěn hǎochī.
sentences.en: The food my mom cooks is delicious.

sentences.zh: 他买的那本书真的很有意思。
sentences.pinyin: Tā mǎi de nà běn shū zhēn de hěn yǒu yìsi.
sentences.en: The book he bought is really interesting.

sentences.zh: 他昨天说的话让我想了很久。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuótiān shuō de huà ràng wǒ xiǎng le hěn jiǔ.
sentences.en: What he said yesterday made me think for a long time.

sentences.zh: 他那种不在乎的态度，真的让人很无奈。
sentences.pinyin: Tā nà zhǒng bù zàihu de tàidu, zhēn de ràng rén hěn wúnài.
sentences.en: His couldn't-care-less attitude is genuinely frustrating.

sentences.zh: 我有一个苹果。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yī ge píngguǒ.
sentences.en: I have one apple.

sentences.zh: 我每天早上喝一杯咖啡。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang hē yī bēi kāfēi.
sentences.en: I have a cup of coffee every morning.

sentences.zh: 一个人去旅行也很有意思。
sentences.pinyin: Yī ge rén qù lǚxíng yě hěn yǒu yìsi.
sentences.en: Travelling alone can be really fun too.

sentences.zh: 他们一见面就聊了很长时间。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen yī jiànmiàn jiù liáo le hěn cháng shíjiān.
sentences.en: The moment they met, they talked for ages.

sentences.zh: 他一开口，大家就知道他是南方人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yī kāikǒu, dàjiā jiù zhīdào tā shì nánfāng rén.
sentences.en: The moment he spoke, everyone could tell he was from the south.

sentences.zh: 他是老师。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shì lǎoshī.
sentences.en: He is a teacher.

sentences.zh: 今天是我的生日，我很高兴。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān shì wǒ de shēngrì, wǒ hěn gāoxìng.
sentences.en: Today is my birthday and I'm very happy.

sentences.zh: 问题是我们的时间不够。
sentences.pinyin: Wèntí shì wǒmen de shíjiān bùgòu.
sentences.en: The problem is we don't have enough time.

sentences.zh: 他是那种说到做到的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shì nà zhǒng shuō dào zuò dào de rén.
sentences.en: He is the kind of person who does what he says.

sentences.zh: 能不能成功，关键是你有没有坚持下去的决心。
sentences.pinyin: Néng bu néng chénggōng, guānjiàn shì nǐ yǒu méiyǒu jiānchí xiàqù de juéxīn.
sentences.en: Whether you succeed or not comes down to whether you have the determination to keep going.

sentences.zh: 我不喝咖啡。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bù hē kāfēi.
sentences.en: I don't drink coffee.

sentences.zh: 他今天不舒服，不去上课了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jīntiān bù shūfu, bù qù shàngkè le.
sentences.en: He doesn't feel well today and isn't going to class.

sentences.zh: 这件事不太容易，但我会试试。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì bù tài róngyì, dàn wǒ huì shì shi.
sentences.en: This isn't very easy, but I'll give it a go.

sentences.zh: 不管多忙，他每天都会给家人打电话。
sentences.pinyin: Bùguǎn duō máng, tā měi tiān dōu huì gěi jiārén dǎ diànhuà.
sentences.en: No matter how busy he is, he calls his family every day.

sentences.zh: 他不是不明白，只是不想面对现实而已。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù shì bù míngbai, zhǐshì bù xiǎng miànduì xiànshí éryǐ.
sentences.en: It's not that he doesn't understand — he just doesn't want to face reality.

sentences.zh: 我吃了一个苹果。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ chī le yī ge píngguǒ.
sentences.en: I ate an apple.

sentences.zh: 他学了两年中文了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xué le liǎng nián Zhōngwén le.
sentences.en: He has been studying Chinese for two years now.

sentences.zh: 下课了，我们去吃饭吧。
sentences.pinyin: Xià kè le, wǒmen qù chīfàn ba.
sentences.en: Class is over — let's go and eat.

sentences.zh: 他工作了一整天，回家就睡着了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gōngzuò le yī zhěng tiān, huí jiā jiù shuìzháo le.
sentences.en: He worked the whole day and fell asleep as soon as he got home.

sentences.zh: 经历了这些事，她对很多东西的看法都变了。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnglì le zhèxiē shì, tā duì hěn duō dōngxi de kànfǎ dōu biàn le.
sentences.en: After going through all this, her perspective on a lot of things has shifted.

sentences.zh: 我在家学习。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zài jiā xuéxí.
sentences.en: I'm studying at home.

sentences.zh: 他在图书馆看书。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài túshūguǎn kànshū.
sentences.en: He is reading at the library.

sentences.zh: 我们在讨论这个问题的时候，他进来了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zài tǎolùn zhège wèntí de shíhou, tā jìnlái le.
sentences.en: He walked in while we were discussing the problem.

sentences.zh: 他在国外住了几年，反而更想回家了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài guówài zhù le jǐ nián, fǎn'ér gèng xiǎng huí jiā le.
sentences.en: After living abroad for a few years, he actually misses home even more.

sentences.zh: 在这个竞争激烈的时代，保持平常心很不容易。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhège jìngzhēng jīliè de shídài, bǎochí píngcháng xīn hěn bù róngyì.
sentences.en: In this intensely competitive era, it's not easy to keep a level head.

sentences.zh: 那个人是我的老师。
sentences.pinyin: Nà ge rén shì wǒ de lǎoshī.
sentences.en: That person is my teacher.

sentences.zh: 这里的人都很友好。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de rén dōu hěn yǒuhǎo.
sentences.en: The people here are all very friendly.

sentences.zh: 每个人都有自己的烦恼。
sentences.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu zìjǐ de fánnǎo.
sentences.en: Everyone has their own worries.

sentences.zh: 他是个做事很认真的人，大家都信任他。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shì ge zuòshì hěn rènzhēn de rén, dàjiā dōu xìnrèn tā.
sentences.en: He is someone who takes everything seriously, and everyone trusts him.

sentences.zh: 一个成熟的人，不会轻易被别人的话所影响。
sentences.pinyin: Yī ge chéngshú de rén, bù huì qīngyì bèi biéren de huà suǒ yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.en: A mature person won't easily be swayed by what others say.

sentences.zh: 我有一个姐姐。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yī ge jiějie.
sentences.en: I have an older sister.

sentences.zh: 这个城市有很多好吃的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì yǒu hěn duō hǎochī de.
sentences.en: This city has so much good food.

sentences.zh: 你有没有时间帮我一下？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu méiyǒu shíjiān bāng wǒ yīxià?
sentences.en: Do you have a moment to help me out?

sentences.zh: 有些话说出来，反而会更麻烦。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu xiē huà shuō chūlai, fǎn'ér huì gèng máfan.
sentences.en: Some things are better left unsaid — saying them just makes things worse.

sentences.zh: 有能力是一回事，愿不愿意去做又是另一回事。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu nénglì shì yī huí shì, yuàn bu yuànyì qù zuò yòu shì lìng yī huí shì.
sentences.en: Having the ability is one thing; actually being willing to do it is quite another.

sentences.zh: 我是学生。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shì xuésheng.
sentences.en: I am a student.

sentences.zh: 我今天有点累，想早点睡。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān yǒudiǎn lèi, xiǎng zǎodiǎn shuì.
sentences.en: I'm a bit tired today and want to go to bed early.

sentences.zh: 我觉得这个方法比较简单。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhège fāngfǎ bǐjiào jiǎndān.
sentences.en: I think this method is pretty straightforward.

sentences.zh: 我一直以为他会来，结果他没来。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yīzhí yǐwéi tā huì lái, jiéguǒ tā méi lái.
sentences.en: I kept thinking he would show up, but in the end he didn't.

sentences.zh: 我不是不想帮你，只是现在真的没有能力。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bù shì bù xiǎng bāng nǐ, zhǐshì xiànzài zhēn de méiyǒu nénglì.
sentences.en: It's not that I don't want to help you — I genuinely can't right now.

sentences.zh: 他是我的朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shì wǒ de péngyǒu.
sentences.en: He is my friend.

sentences.zh: 他每天早上去跑步。
sentences.pinyin: Tā měi tiān zǎoshang qù pǎobù.
sentences.en: He goes running every morning.

sentences.zh: 他虽然很忙，但还是来了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suīrán hěn máng, dàn háishi lái le.
sentences.en: Even though he was really busy, he still came.

sentences.zh: 他说话不多，但每次说的都很有道理。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà bù duō, dàn měi cì shuō de dōu hěn yǒu dàolǐ.
sentences.en: He doesn't say much, but whenever he does it always makes sense.

sentences.zh: 他从不抱怨，遇到什么事都能平静地面对。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóng bù bàoyuàn, yùdào shénme shì dōu néng píngjìng de miànduì.
sentences.en: He never complains and faces whatever comes his way with calm.
